remarks: Discover the ultimate blend of modern luxury and traditional elegance in this beautifully renovated New England Colonial. Perched on a private lot with expansive views, this home exudes sophistication with its abundance of natural light and luxurious finishes.  Every detail has been meticulously designed, from the Calcutta marble kitchen counters and fireplace surrounds to the walnut butcher block kitchen island and marble floors in the bathrooms. The spacious interiors are filled with natural light, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The home is equipped with a state-of-the-art smart system, providing effortless control over lighting, climate, and entertainment.  The outdoor spaces are designed for extraordinary entertaining, featuring a cascading three-tier deck, a heated pool, and beautifully landscaped grounds. The entire property is fenced for wildlife, ensuring privacy and tranquility. The home is supported by a comprehensive infrastructure, including a full drainage system, a whole-house generator, and an irrigation system, ensuring comfort and peace of mind year-round.
